vectors.name: a=q answers ok and echoes n
an unknown action is EINVAL
a bad surface name is EINVAL
a command for a missing surface is ENOENT
doc, then a text patch
a missing target is ENOTARGET with the id as detail
q=1 answers only errors; q=2 never answers
place answers with c and r; bad sizes are EINVAL
a window shows part of the surface; one that leaves it, or has no cells, is EINVAL
z orders overlapping placements: an integer from -1000 to 1000, else EINVAL
p=1 asks for presses; the placement answers as any other
a drag reports dragstart, a drag for each element crossed and each cell crossed outside them, and dragend, with the cell and the keys

vectors.name: a drag that ends on the element it began on is a click as well; one that ends elsewhere is not

steps.payload: AB

vectors.name: only an element with an id and drag in its data-on starts a drag
hide and a new document end a drag with dragend; a detached surface reports nothing more
a press with Alt is the program's: the surface hears nothing of it or of its gesture, whatever p asked for; the press decides, not the keys held later

steps.payload: AB

vectors.name: hide keeps the document: patches apply, and placing it again needs no doc
append morphs a child with the same id in place, and appends the rest
prepend inserts first
morph brings attributes and text in line with the payload
morph is the default op
morph without t matches top-level elements by id; a missing one is ENOTARGET
morph with several top-level elements replaces the target with them
inner matches children by id, then by position and kind
replace swaps the element without morphing
before and after insert siblings; remove removes
attr sets and unattr removes an attribute; both need k
text replaces all children with one text node
table rows parse in their context
doc replaces the whole document
cid: references keep the program's URL
network URLs and links keep the program's values, whatever the base and the policy
del removes a surface; later commands for it are ENOENT
res stores and del removes a resource
focus on a missing element is ENOTARGET
detach answers ok, and the detached surface refuses the keyboard with EDETACHED
detaching keeps the document as the program wrote it: patches apply, controls report no disabled
d=1 on doc creates the surface detached; a doc without it gives it back to the program
pointer-events: none lets the pointer through: no press, drag or click there, whatever p asked for; an element with pointer-events: auto takes it back; the press decides

steps.payload: AH

vectors.name: f=1 hears the rows a document needs when they differ from the placement's
f=1 on r=auto is silent until the document's height changes; a patch that changes it is heard, the placement keeps its rows
a resource that arrives late and changes the height is heard with f=1
without f=1 nothing is heard; placing again without it stops fit, and with it starts from the new placement's rows
v=1 hears hover each time the nearest element with an id under the pointer changes, and out when the pointer leaves the window or the terminal
without v=1 nothing is heard; v=1 starts from out and lives with the placement: placing again with it goes on, without it or hidden it stops
a held button holds hover: none from the press to the release, which reports where the pointer is after its other events; a drag reports its own
a press with Alt takes the pointer from the window: out, and no hover until the release
from one window to another, the first one's out comes before the second one's hover; a detached surface sends none
where the pointer passes through a window, it is out of it

wire.name: a chunked command reassembles; continuation chunks carry only m
an interrupted chunked command is invalid, and the next command works
